Offline.description:
Device-chain versions. Readers accept every supported version; these two knobs roll writers forward safely.
chain_writer_version: what scanners should write next (raise only after every reader understands it).
chain_min_version: the floor. A newer event below it is recorded for reconciliation but never gets load authority.

get.description:
Durable recovery for a client that was not connected: committed outbox events (the same envelope the socket
sends) at or after `since`, at or above `min_severity`, plus anything that sounded the siren. Served from the
outbox itself, so an event is here even if its live push was never delivered. At most the last 24 h.
